Title: Upcoming changes to Databricks materialized views and streaming tables in Databricks SQL

Body.Content:
You're receiving this update because you've enrolled in the preview for materialized views and streaming tables in Databricks SQL.

 

Starting 20 May 2024, creating and refreshing MVs and STs will be charged at the Automated Serverless Compute billing rate meter. Currently, usage is charged to the Serverless SQL Compute billing meter. These changes will roll out across all global regions over several weeks, no action is required from you.

You can check the billing rate using these steps.

 

If you have any questions or concerns, please contact us.
